Holder Clough Capital Partners LP Raised Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) Stake; Rollins (ROL) Market Valuation Rose While Conestoga Capital Advisors Has Trimmed Its Stake by $1.84 Million
May 7, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Charles Clough increased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by 10.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clough Capital Partners LP bought 34,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Charles Clough held 357,100 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $38.19 million, up from 322,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clough Capital Partners LP who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $371.92B market cap company. The stock increased 0.76% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $109.25. About 6.76M shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 23.99% since May 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.44% the S&P500.
Conestoga Capital Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Rollins Inc (ROL) by 5.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Conestoga Capital Advisors Llc sold 40,057 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.55% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 700,467 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $32.59 million, down from 740,524 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Conestoga Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Rollins Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.94 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.19% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $50.13. About 289,108 shares traded. Rollins, Inc. (NYSE:ROL) has risen 40.64% since May 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 29.09% the S&P500.
